environment: LOCAL isolated PGlite and Microsoft Edge

cases.name: Admin uploads a real PDF through the browser with Vietnamese metadata
Admin desktop/mobile pages use the existing CRM table layout without file-read controls
Cross-origin, extra-audience fields and oversize multipart bodies are rejected
Accountant and all three warehouse roles can view, preview and download, and cannot upload
Manager, sales and both dealer roles have no menu, page, list, download or upload access
New files do not bypass the old private-document endpoint and retired modules remain closed
